memoryCapacity.scope: Four-writer materializer-phase memory-only calculations, not a whole worker peak or observed production concurrency. No scheduler, worker-slot or Admin settings changed.

routineRunnerMapping.scope: Static runner mapping only. Recent production-host measurements and actual concurrent admission were not inspected; Admin settings and scheduler behavior are unchanged.
routineRunnerMapping.recentMeasurementRule: Largest of the last five completed job family peaks, plus 5% rounded up to MiB, replaces the table fallback; actual available memory, parent growth and existing reservations also affect admission.

noHistoryFallbackOnlyArithmetic.scope: Conditional arithmetic for the 342 MiB table default alone, not observed or predicted production admission. Recent host peaks and other live memory are unknown.

runtimeScope: Continuous same production shared iterator, normalizer, full-source binding, compact writer, and four pending EvidenceStore writes. The proof-only level1 gzip codec retains exact logical bytes and metadata. Every gzip call and encoded file write stays in the measured total; no exact artifact readback, pause, or timing deduction occurs. Production Netlify latency and fresh source network latency are unmeasured.

infrastructureRetry.replacement: Fresh proof-only gzip-level1 stores; exact production logical bytes and metadata; same shared production materializer; every codec cost included

preparation.nextRunCondition: Fresh logical stores; shared level1 gzip included in full elapsed; closed held SQLite cache was advised away before preparation, exact bytes retained; no source or production settings changed.

postTimingClosedSourceCacheRelease.scope: Post-timing cleanup of only closed immutable source SQLite clean pages, after complete sourceDBclose; no bytes removed, outputvault untouched. No time deduction.

holds.reason: Quiet final EPA first-page API/card and clientbrowser proof; only separate offline comparison paused, completed national source/materializer untouched.

comparison.scope: Exhaustive offline artifact and primary-ID verification. Its wall time includes quiet reader/profile holds; no verification time enters the measured production processing sum.

productionEquivalent.scope: Conservative changed-edition processing: the actual archive HTTP download, measured held-byte source ingestion and unchanged indexing, complete continuous four-writer materialization, actual production registration reads, actual national publisher and actual retention over all primary records for the17 real gaps. No extrapolated rows or latency deductions; all proof-codec overhead remains included. Future source HTTP and production remote-vault latency are unmeasured.

readerVerificationScope: Normal API, cards, and Ask correctness and first-use SQL performance are reported separately in epa-reader-all-states.json. This artifact measures complete source materialization, exact output equivalence, and processing budget.
